## Verification

<!-- List automated and manual checks. Use N/A with a reason where appropriate. -->

## Release impact

- [ ] Added a Changeset for published-package changes
- [ ] No Changeset is needed (docs, tests, CI, or unreleased app only)

## Safety and provenance
